about.title: Travel is better when it feels human.
about.intro: GuideMyTrip connects curious travellers with local people who can show them more than a checklist.

sections.title: A more considered way to go
sections.body: We are building a platform for thoughtful trips, local context, and clear expectations. This content is a working business draft and should be reviewed before publication.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: This is configurable business content, not legal advice. Have the final terms reviewed by your legal advisor before launch.

sections.title: Service terms
sections.body: GuideMyTrip terms, responsibilities, booking conditions, and limitations will be published here after business and legal review.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This configurable draft describes the intended policy location and does not make legal guarantees.

sections.title: Your information
sections.body: The final policy should explain what information GuideMyTrip collects, why it is used, retention, rights, providers, and contact details.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.intro: The cancellation policy attached to each package controls the applicable refund calculation.

sections.title: Before you book
sections.body: Review the cancellation policy shown in your booking summary. Refund status and payment-provider processing are tracked in your account.

faqs.eyebrow: A few things you might wonder
faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: We keep the important details easy to find.

sections.title: How are guides selected?
sections.body: Guides are approved and verified through the GuideMyTrip operations process. Availability and language fit are checked for each request.

sections.title: What happens after payment?
sections.body: A verified payment confirms the booking. You can see status, dates, guide information, and refunds in your dashboard.

safety.title: Safety guidelines
safety.intro: Practical guidance for a more prepared trip.

sections.title: Before and during your trip
sections.body: Share accurate traveller details, follow local guidance, keep emergency contacts available, and contact GuideMyTrip support if something feels wrong.

help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Send us the details and our team will review your request.

sections.title: Need help with a booking?
sections.body: Include your booking reference and the best way to reach you when contacting support.

become-guide.title: Become a Guide
become-guide.intro: Turn your local knowledge into meaningful work.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Apply with your profile, languages, destinations, experience, and availability. GuideMyTrip reviews applications before approval.
